name: Necromancy Rituals — 1 Basic — Ritual of the Smoking Mirror

system.description: Using a sharpened obsidian mirror that cuts the hand that holds it, the Pisanob Necromancer chooses one of two aspects for the scene: Lifesight, which grants the ability to read auras as with the Auspex power Aura Perception, or Deathsight, which grants sight into the Shadowlands and lets a knowledgeable Necromancer diagnose illness, injury, or disability in a subject (Perception + Medicine equivalent) or study the flaws of an object with a strong link to life- or death-energy.
system.source: Clanbook: Giovanni, Chapter Two: It Runs in the Family
